title: LIBRI INTERIORS — Interior Design Studio
hero-desc:
A home shouldn't just be beautiful.
It should feel like you.
about_lead:
A home always tells a story. I'm Olena Suvorova, founder of Libri Interiors.
My passion for interior design has accompanied me for many years – from my creative roots in Ukraine to Germany.
about_p2: For us, good design emerges where aesthetics, function and individuality are in harmony. Every home is as unique as the people who live in it. That's why we don't think in standards, but in solutions.
role_alex: The technical mind behind the ideas.
quotes.hero_quote: Where others see limits, we see possibilities. Together we turn ideas into places where people love to live.
portfolio_project_text: A home that preserves memories. Inspired by Ukrainian symbols and reinterpreted for modern living.
portfolio_title_1: Living and dining area – The heart of Ukrainian Soul
portfolio_description_2: A retreat full of warmth and memories.
portfolio_description_3: Every detail carries the soul of the concept.
services_description_1:
Inspiration without limits.

Digital interior consultation for clients worldwide. You receive a personalised moodboard, a colour and material concept and a carefully curated shopping list – simple, convenient and online.
services_description_2:
See it before it exists.

Photorealistic visualisations let you experience your future home. Colours, light and materials become visible before implementation begins, so you make decisions with confidence and joy.
services_description_3:
Spaces with character.

Well-thought-out floor plans, harmonious room layouts and individual design concepts create a home that perfectly suits your lifestyle and aesthetic standards.
process_title: To the perfect space in 4 steps
process_step1_desc: We listen closely. We get to know your lifestyle, your needs and your budget.
process_step2_desc: Your vision takes shape. Development of the space plan, colour palette and photorealistic 3D images.
process_step3_desc: Perfection down to the smallest detail. Creation of all technical plans and selection of the exact materials & furniture.
process_step4_desc: From concept to reality. Professional support for a result that matches your dreams exactly.
cta_story_description:
Perhaps you already carry your future home in your mind.
Tell us about it.
Together we'll turn it into a place where you love to find yourself every day.
faq_title: Questions you ask – answers that delight you
answer1: Don't worry, we guide you through the entire process. It all starts with a cup of coffee (or a video call) where we uncover your dreams and habits. Then we turn your wishes into a well-thought-out 3D concept – down to the last detail and the perfect implementation.
question2: Do you also offer consultation for individual rooms?
answer2: Absolutely. Big changes often start small. Whether it's redesigning your living room, an inspiring home office or an entire villa – we give every square metre the same love for detail.
answer3: Good design knows no borders. Thanks to our well-designed E-Design concept, we support your project from anywhere. You receive photorealistic 3D visualisations, floor plans and a ready-made shopping list – no matter where you are.
question4: What happens if I don't like the first draft?
answer4: Design is a dialogue, not a monologue. We listen closely before we draw the first line. If something doesn't yet match your ideas 100%, we refine the concept together until you say: “Yes, that's exactly me!”
question5: Do you adapt to our budget?
answer5: Transparency is our priority. Aesthetics isn't a question of unlimited budget, but of smart design. We plan realistically from the start so that your vision becomes reality without financial surprises.
question6: Why should we work with Libri Interiors?
answer6: Because you get two perspectives on your project. We combine creative vision with technical precision. You don't have to choose between beauty and functionality – with us you get both from a single source.
